spans.text: [16] AR: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ EN: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein

folded.id: and we|did|certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days
folded.subject: And We
folded.object: certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days

spans.text: [38] AR: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ EN: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

folded.id: and we|have|given life thereby to a dead land
folded.subject: and We
folded.object: given life thereby to a dead land

spans.text: [11] AR: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ EN: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land.

folded.id: and we|have|removed from you your cover
folded.subject: and We

spans.text: [22] AR: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ EN: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."

folded.id: before them|did|we destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands
folded.subject: before them
folded.object: We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands

spans.text: [36] AR: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ EN: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands.

folded.id: but they|are|in confusion over a new creation
folded.subject: But they
folded.object: in confusion over a new creation

spans.text: But they are in confusion over a new creation.

folded.id: but they|denied|the truth when it came to them
folded.subject: But they
folded.object: the truth when it came to them

spans.text: [5] AR: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ EN: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

[27] AR: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ EN: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

folded.id: day they|will|hear the blast [of the horn] in truth
folded.subject: Day they
folded.object: hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth

spans.text: [42] AR: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ EN: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth.
[30] AR: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ EN: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?"
[15] AR: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ EN: Did We fail in the first creation?
[21] AR: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ EN: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.

folded.id: how we|structured|it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
folded.subject: how We
folded.object: it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

spans.text: [6] AR: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ EN: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

[27] AR: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ EN: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

folded.id: in that|is|a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind]
folded.subject: in that
folded.object: a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind]

spans.text: [37] AR: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ EN: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

folded.id: it|is|we who give life and cause death
folded.subject: it
folded.object: We who give life and cause death

spans.text: [43] AR: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

[22] AR: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ EN: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
[32] AR: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ EN: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]

folded.id: most merciful|unseen|and came with a heart returning [in repentance]
folded.subject: Most Merciful
folded.object: and came with a heart returning [in repentance]

spans.text: [33] AR: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ EN: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
[19] AR: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ EN: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
[12] AR: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ EN: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
[5] AR: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ EN: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
That is a distant return."

folded.id: that|is|the day of [carrying out] the threat
folded.subject: That
folded.object: the Day of [carrying out] the threat

spans.text: That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

folded.id: that|is|the day of emergence [from the graves]
folded.subject: That
folded.object: the Day of Emergence [from the graves]

spans.text: That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

folded.id: that|is|what you were trying to avoid
folded.subject: that
folded.object: what you were trying to avoid

spans.text: [19] AR: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ EN: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

folded.id: the caller|will|call out from a place that is near -
folded.subject: the Caller
folded.object: call out from a place that is near -

spans.text: [41] AR: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ EN: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
[20] AR: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ EN: And the Horn will be blown.

folded.id: the word|will|not be changed with me
folded.subject: The word

spans.text: [29] AR: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ EN: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
[35] AR: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ EN: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

[2] AR: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ EN: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
This is the Day of Eternity."
[23] AR: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ EN: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

folded.id: this|is|what you were promised - for every returner [to allah] and keeper [of his covenant]
folded.subject: This
folded.object: what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]

spans.text: [32] AR: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ EN: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
Thus is the resurrection.
[43] AR: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

folded.id: we|know|what the earth diminishes of them
folded.subject: We
folded.object: what the earth diminishes of them

spans.text: [4] AR: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ EN: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

folded.id: we|spread|it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind
folded.subject: We
folded.object: it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind

spans.text: [7] AR: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ EN: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
[3] AR: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ EN: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]?

folded.id: when we|have|died and have become dust
folded.subject: When we

spans.text: [3] AR: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ EN: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]?

[9] AR: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ EN: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

[16] AR: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ EN: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
[18] AR: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ EN: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
[4] AR: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ EN: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
[35] AR: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ EN: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
